title: Municipal Rankings
scope: This first ledger ranks Massachusetts cities and towns on 2020-to-2024 Census population change. Crime, debt, education, spending, revenue, and tax rankings are listed as later views.
exclusions: Does not cover the per-town atlas stock (Municipal Atlas), Boston payroll, or advice about a town meeting warrant. DLS, DESE, and crime rankings are pending.
heritage: Formerly the Cities and Towns Rankings suite
vintage_note: Rebuilt Aug 15, 2026 from Census sub-est2024_25.csv, SUMLEV 061. This first ranking is 2024 minus 2020 resident population. Crime, debt, education, expenditure, revenue, and tax rankings remain pending.

SRC-626-01.name: Census vintage 2024 subcounty population estimates, Massachusetts
SRC-626-01.supports: This first ledger ranks Massachusetts cities and towns on 2020-to-2024 Census population change. Crime, debt, education, spending, revenue, and tax rankings are listed as later views.

q: Rank Massachusetts cities and towns on crime, debt, education, spending, revenues, and taxes.
lead: From 2020 to 2024 the largest population gain among Massachusetts cities and towns was Amherst Town city at 13,183; the largest loss was Boston city at -2,064 (derived, SRC-626-01). Crime, debt, education, spending, and tax rankings are pending because those DLS and DESE files were not reachable this pass.

kpis.label: Largest gain, 2020-24
kpis.why: The top of this first ranking is raw population change, not crime or debt.

kpis.label: Largest loss, 2020-24
kpis.why: The bottom of the ranking is the largest population decline.
